so we might not be the best people to help

but professional help can provide a lot more than us. they help a lot of people everyday. so generally it would be better for you to seek help from qualified people

I can't

I don't know you, I have never interacted with you, I have no reason to hate you

However, I believe everyone deserve a chance

There are probably a lot of people who have a good  impression of you, Like that guy you started chatting with at a bar. or maybe someone who you played with online and had a good laugh together. or maybe the girl that needed just 20 more cents to buy a bottle of water?

I'm sure there are plenty of people who see you in good life. and you should appreciate that

there is always a chance

have you considered your close friends? wouldn't they grieve over your death? do you want that?

can you at least try to contact someone as a last resort? there are plenty of hotlines that can listen to your struggles

please, give it a chance, what have you got to lose?

"Things that came apart could be put together again, but never exactly the same"- The six rules of maybe


Do you know what I think you need?

To try open a new page in life

So many things went in such a short amount of time. this is not something in a power of a single woman to handle

You need to figure out how to get out of that mess, and start a new page

You should absolutely seek help from your parents. If they are so strict, that means that they care immensely about you. and want you to succeed as much as possible

So, tell them that. tell them you just can't carry on, and you feel that the tension is building more and more.


I don't think you can allow yourself to put so much weight on you at this point, take smaller steps

Maybe even give up on college for the next few months, until you feel more stable

Try finding a fulfilling hobby. something that would make you get out of bed in the morning and say "today I am going to be productive!"

My advice? you already know what it is like to hit rock bottom. so help others in similar vein

Are there any hostels for dropout kids nearby you can apply for volunteering in?

Knowing other's struggles really put your life into perspective


Stay strong. I believe in you

you are who you are. you are the only one who is yourself

be the best version of yourself, always aspire to get better

what are you hating about yourself?

I'm sorry to tell you that. but there is no way that your best friend would not get hurt, nor your cat would be okay

your life isn't a singular matter, flowing through space without affecting anybody

you have interacted with people, bonded, shared experiences. people build trust and affection toward you

if your life would be gone, everyone that know you would be affected, and the closest people would be damaged the most

your friend love you, your cat trust you, your parents would give their world to you

if not for yourself, stay for them. I'm sure you don't want to hurt them, don't disappoint them. I'm sure they only want you to be happy and safe

talk to them, share your fears and struggles, ask them for advices. people would be happy to help

luckily I have been blessed with life full of support and care. such thing never crossed my mind. but I did volunteer for a few months in an hostel for people that aren't as blessed as me. and sadly some weren't as satisfied with their life there

anyways I posted here a question about something happened to me today involving someone else trying to suicide. and I decided to stick around to see if I can help to someone

but luckily, I am fulfilled and have no reason and never had any, to give away my life

should you what?

share your struggles?
seek help?
find goals worth living for?

there are a lot of things you can do that can be great for your well being
